text_block_list.text: —Ahaha, ahahaha☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: (It's fun! I'm so happy! My heart feels like it's going to burst!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: (I can feel Mayano's breath, her heartbeat... and her desire to shine! ☆★)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaagh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(I want to layer them even more☆
Mayano and my Marvelous!!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mayanoooo!!!!
Amazing, amazing! That was so marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mayano, you worked so hard!
Mayano's Marvelous grew
so many times bigger!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Running together conveys so much!☆
What Mayano is feeling, and what thoughts are in her head as she runs!★☆"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Nihihi♪
Maya totally gets how you feel, Mave-chin!
I could really feel how happy you were to run☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So let's run together again, okay?☆
Maya's gonna get way, way stronger,
so make sure you keep up and don't fall behind! Promise♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
That's right, Maya's gonna get even stronger!
'Cause I promised to show him—!
I greet Marvelous Sunday in the underground tunnel after her race.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I'm back, Trainer!!
I just ran the Kikuka Sho!!
choice_data_list: Good work! That was a great attempt!
Good work! That was a great attempt!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it felt soo-oo-o good! ☆★
GⅠs really are something special――!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
The people in the crowd! The racing Umamusume!
Because everyone's feelings are so strong,
the Marvelous that's born from it is super huge too☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I wanna run in a big race again☆
I want to deliver that marvelous feeling to everyone once more★

Looks like she enjoyed the big stage without feeling intimidated!
Her positivity is so reassuring at times like this.
choice_data_list: With this, the Challenge Cup should be in the bag!
With this, we should be all set for the Challenge Cup!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me☆
I'll keep polishing my running with this momentum★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Full steam ahead toward the next Marvelous☆★☆

There was not a shred of worry in her enthusiastic figure.
With this race as a catalyst,
Marvelous Sunday will surely grow even further!
Yes. Smooth sailing, feeling good about it—or so I certainly felt up until this moment...
